title: visual-explainer narration, version 3
description: The spoken text of the video, one entry for each scene. render-video.mjs also checks that each scene is a scene of the mode, appears once, follows the scene order of the mode (plan: intro, tldr, done-when, phases, architecture, decisions, rabbit-holes, outro; ship: intro, tldr, done-when, changes, findings, hand-test, rollback, outro), that intro is present, that each text has 10 to 90 words and all texts 80 to 450 words, and that the props have data for each scene. A scene that the narration omits is not in the video.

scene.description: The scene id. The mode limits the ids: see the description of the schema.
